question: Which union territory became the first to achieve full functional literacy under the ULLAS-Nav Bharat Saaksharta Karyakram?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ladakh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ladakh has become the first administrative unit** to achieve full functional literacy under the ULLAS-Nav Bharat Saaksharta Karyakram (New India Literacy Program).
 
• The Union Territory **has surpassed 97% literacy, marking a major success for the centrally sponsored scheme.**
 
• ULLAS is a **centrally sponsored scheme that aims to improve the literacy and numeracy skills of adults aged 15 and above. **
 
• **The scheme is also known as the New India Literacy Programme (NILP). **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The scheme is based on volunteerism, where volunteers teach non-literate people through the ULLAS Mobile App. **
 
• **The scheme's goal is to help adults who didn't receive a proper education to contribute to the country's growth. **
 
• **The scheme's components includ**e foundational literacy, numeracy, critical life skills, basic education, vocational skills, and continuing education.
